text:
Rachel: post-deploy quick smoke for routing-service (us-central) — canary v2.7.0 rolled 10m ago. Observed spike in tail latency and sporadic 502 gateway responses on /v1/predict. Baseline p95 ~140ms, seen ~1.6s.

Deploy-bot: Canary completed 8m ago. No auto-rollback.

Rachel: tagging @tom @priya — suggest PAUSE further rollout and pin to v2.6.9 until we verify.

Tom: looking at dashboards now. Heatmap shows proxy-host-03 high queue_time and 502 cluster at 17:42 UTC.

Priya: can we repro with a targeted smoke that pins to proxy-host-02..04 and uses the canary header? smokebot run please.

Rachel: smokebot, run 60 reqs, concurrency 6, target hosts 02..04, model v2.7.0:
```
curl -s -X POST 'https://synth.redwood/check' \ 
  -H 'x-region: us-central' \ 
  -H 'x-model: v2.7.0' \ 
  -H 'x-target-hosts: proxy-host-02,proxy-host-03,proxy-host-04' \ 
  -d '{"route":"/v1/predict","input":"test"}'
```

Smokebot: starting job 3628800123-s1 (60 reqs, concurrency 6) against proxy-host-02..04.

Smokebot: job complete — 4/60 returned 502, p95=1600ms, median=95ms. Failures all routed via proxy-host-03.

Tom: scope narrowed to proxy-host-03. Checking kernel logs and socket stats. Seeing spikes in accept queue length and repeated ECONNRESET upstream.

Priya: runtime metrics show increased epoll wait latencies on proxy-host-03 around the same time. Any recent infra changes?

Infra-oncall: no infra config changes in the window. We did push a kernel patch on a different pool last week, unrelated.

Rachel: decision: pin traffic back to v2.6.9 and keep canary artifact for debugging. We'll collect tcpdump + strace from proxy-host-03 and run jemalloc stats on the router process.

Tom: applying pin now — routing weights: v2.7.0 -> 0%, v2.6.9 -> 100%. ETA ~70s.

Deploy-bot: Traffic updated — v2.7.0 weight set to 0%. v2.6.9 weight set to 100%. Canary artifact retained for investigation.

Priya: commands I'll run on proxy-host-03:
```
sudo tcpdump -c 1000 -w /tmp/proxy-host-03.pcap -i eth0 'tcp'
sudo strace -f -tt -o /tmp/strace.session $(pgrep routing-service)
sudo jemalloc_ps_dump > /tmp/jemalloc.json
```
Uploading results to s3://redwood-debug/3628800123/.

Tom: starting pprof on routing-service and pulling logs from kibana slice 17:30-17:50.

Rachel: opening ticket RED-1420 with synth job 3628800123-s1 and planned artifacts. Assigning to runtime/perf.

Infra-oncall: note: change freeze until 23:00 UTC. If we need extended work, escalate to infra pager.

Priya: after pin, rerun a quick synthetic sweep to validate there are no residual 502s. smokebot, run a 40-req validation against standard routing pool (no canary header).

Smokebot: starting job 3628800123-val1 (40 reqs).

Smokebot: validation complete — 0/40 failed, p95=150ms.

Rachel: good. We'll leave the pin in place while runtime/perf analyzes dumps. I'll post updates in RED-1420 and notify #status if SLOs change. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:

Tom: +1, monitoring for 30m and will post any anomalies.

Priya: uploading pcaps and strace to s3://redwood-debug/3628800123/proxy-host-03/ now.

Rachel: closing this quick thread. Follow-up + postmortem will be in RED-1420.
